axis_defs.accuracy: overall stable accuracy % on the 149-fixture corpus (higher better)
axis_defs.robustness: worst-category stable accuracy % across the 7 scenario categories (higher better)
axis_defs.speed: median LLM-call latency in seconds; inverted on the chart so faster = farther from center (lower better)

_meta.source: accuracy/robustness from results/baselines/post-fix-isolated-*.txt (Chart 8 per-category); speed from results/baselines/convex-perf-*-n5.txt (Chart 5)
